name: Per-face Normal Repetition
aliases: Per-face normal repetition for cube vertices
definition: A vertex buffer layout technique where each face of a cube is assigned a single outward-facing normal vector, repeated for all four vertices of that face to achieve flat shading and correct per-face lighting.
summary: Per-face Normal Repetition is a voxel rendering technique that duplicates a single outward normal for each cube face's vertices to achieve flat shading and preserve sharp edges.
